Cheese filling to make peynirli [[Cookbook:Börek|börek]]

==Ingredients==
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Cottage cheese|cottage cheese]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta]], crumbled
*1 [[Cookbook:Eggs|egg]], [[Cookbook:Beating|beaten]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]] or [[Cookbook:Dill|dill]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Mix the feta into the cottage cheese by mashing together with a fork.
#Add the beaten egg, chopped herbs and pepper, and stir until just mixed.
#Place in a plastic covered container and refrigerate until ready to use.
#See [[Cookbook:Börek|Börek]] recipe for further instructions.
